answer: Make every identity earn its keep by signing a rolling hardware-attested heartbeat: the node issues a fresh nonce each block and the agent must answer inside a tight window using a key fused to a real device, so a zephyr of clones rented on one box all fail the same latency ridge and get pruned. An attacker who wants a thousand live identities must therefore buy and keep a thousand separate machines powered and online, turning a cheap software fork into a real capex bill, while honest agents pay that cost once and let the plume of savings ride.
